description: A body for table `notes` of the vector schema -> the validated body or an error. insert = full body, patch = partial.

vectors.name: full body
vectors.why: every kind at a valid value

vectors.name: integer 2^53
vectors.why: off point: not a safe integer

vectors.name: number 2^53
vectors.why: a number may exceed the safe range

vectors.name: missing field
vectors.why: a full body needs every field

vectors.name: unknown field
vectors.why: unknown keys are rejected before any field

vectors.name: _version in a patch
vectors.why: versions move only by +1 in SQL

vectors.name: empty patch
vectors.why: a patch may change nothing (and still bumps _version)

vectors.name: patch U+0000
vectors.why: the storage contract applies to patches
